name: agent-crew
description: Agents side panel for any session that uses subagents: what each agent is doing, its progress and its cost. Follows Claude's task list and superpowers plans, in pixel-crab style, with one row above the prompt for progress, model, branch, context and a prompt-cache countdown.

open_panel.title: Open the panel by itself
open_panel.description: Open the Agents panel when a subagent starts. Off: open it with /crew.

hide_agent_list.title: Hide Claude Code's agent list
hide_agent_list.description: Hide the list of agents under the prompt, since the panel shows them. /tasks still works. Takes effect in new sessions.
